market_definition: The PVDF foam market comprises polyvinylidene fluoride foams with chemical resistance, UV stability and piezoelectric properties. It measures sales of PVDF foam sheets, membranes and parts. BY PRODUCT FORM: Sheets, Membranes, Moulded Parts. BY PORE STRUCTURE: Closed-Cell, Open-Cell. BY END-USE INDUSTRY: Chemical Processing, Aerospace & Electronics, Energy Storage & Sensors, Filtration & Medical, Other End-Use Industries. BY REGION: North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia Pacific (APAC), Middle East, Africa. EXCLUDED from the market: Fluoroelastomer foam; PVDF resin, film or membranes without foam structure; PTFE foam. COMPANY TYPE IN THIS LIST - DISTRIBUTOR / CONVERTER: a distributor, stockist or foam converter / fabricator that buys this foam from its makers and sells it (as supplied, or cut, laminated or shaped) to industry. EXCLUDED companies: foam and raw-material makers and their own sales subsidiaries; companies selling only the excluded products; service-only firms.
who_is_included: DISTRIBUTOR DEFINITION (physical goods market): a company whose PRIMARY business is buying in volume from manufacturers and reselling/distributing onward - wholesale, authorized, value-added or stocking distributor. EXCLUDED: channel partners, resellers, VARs, dealers, agents and brokers that do not stock or wholesale; manufacturers and OEMs (including a manufacturer's own sales subsidiary); system integrators; and pure service providers or consultancies. Continent / Geography = countries with a physical site (HQ, office, warehouse, plant). Operational Presence = every country the company does business in, which is WIDER. Blank or NPD in a contact column means no published evidence was found - it is never a guess.
